metadata.description: Update an existing CRM object tag in your HubSpot account.
metadata.learn_more: Update an existing CRM object tag in your HubSpot account. This operation allows you to modify the properties of a tag identified by its objectTypeId and tagId. Use this endpoint to change tag details such as name, color, and associated filters.

objectTypeId.label: Object Type Id
objectTypeId.description: The unique identifier of the object type to which the tag belongs.

tagId.label: Tag Id
tagId.description: The unique identifier of the tag to be updated.

color.label: Color
color.description: A string specifying the color associated with the CRM object tag.

description.label: Description
description.description: A string providing a description of the CRM object tag.

filterBranch.label: Filter Branch
filterBranch.description: An object that defines the filter branch for the CRM object tag. It can be one of several filter branch types, such as PublicOrFilterBranch or PublicAndFilterBranch.

filterPipelineIds.label: Filter Pipeline Ids
filterPipelineIds.description: An array of strings representing the IDs of the pipelines to which the CRM object tag is applicable.

name.label: Name
name.description: A string representing the name of the CRM object tag.
